mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.5pp over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during tightening cycles despite rising FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production signals expanding manufacturing output and improving corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through stronger near-term profit visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% annually signals persistent price pressures, prompting aggressive central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicate labor market tightness, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 3.5%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, declining housing starts signal weakening consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or Rank IC < 0.03.
